items.title: Brazil sees record fall in Amazon deforestation as key election looms
items.description: The Amazon rainforest is a crucial buffer against climate change - but deforestation had expanded under former president Jair Bolsonaro.

items.title: Oregon teacher fought school attacker before armed dad shot suspect 'multiple times'
items.description: The 16-year-old suspect previously attended the primary school and had targeted a special educational needs classroom, police say.

items.title: Trump waives several Russia sanctions as new US law takes effect
items.description: Trump says parts of a new law that aims to punish Moscow for its war against Ukraine are against US national interests.

items.title: Three men jailed for 158 years each for murdering Australian and US surfers in Mexico
items.description: Brothers Jake and Callum Robinson and their friend Carter Rhoad were killed on a surfing trip in an apparent botched robbery.

items.title: Inside Ukrainian offensive pushing Russia back - with Starlink playing a key role
items.description: The BBC joins Ukraine's Operation Vivaldi as it regains crucial territory in the Donbas, but optimism has been dampened by souring relations with President Trump.

items.title: Palestinians and US journalist injured by Israeli settlers in West Bank harvest attack
items.description: The BBC sees masked settlers attack Palestinians trying to harvest olives, amid a surge in similar incidents.

items.title: Katie Zacharia leaving her White House role less than five days on the job
items.description: Her public debut as White House press secretary on Tuesday ended with a flurry of media criticism about her credentials and preparedness.

items.title: Trump 'completely wrong' to restrict support for Ukraine, Italian minister tells BBC
items.description: Defence Minister Guido Crosetto tells the BBC the US risks prolonging Russia's full-scale invasion rather than helping to end it.

items.title: Trial of German steakhouse heiress that sparked a huge spy scandal
items.description: For 15 months, a high-security courtroom in Hamburg has been hearing the case of Christina Block, accused of ordering the abduction of her children.

items.title: Pope pictured for first time since surgery and cancer diagnosis
items.description: The pontiff was diagnosed with lung cancer after having surgery at Rome's Gemelli Hospital on Tuesday.

items.title: Trump denies limiting Ukraine access to Starlink network
items.description: Speed curbs limited Ukraine's defences against deadly Russian attacks on Tuesday night.

items.title: India's 'cockroach' party founder detained ahead of protest
items.description: The youth-led movement had called for a Delhi protest after mass detentions last week and the jailing of two leaders.

items.title: Ship attack reports near Hormuz reach record high as oil exports slow
items.description: BBC Verify analysis of data from a UK maritime agency shows 12 vessels were struck in a week.

items.title: Dad fined after son, 2, died in Cyprus hotel fall
items.description: Joshua Foster "lost control" of his son while showing him the view of a water park from a window.

items.title: Albanian protests turn violent: What we know
items.description: Albania's capital Tirana has seen months of protests from an anti-government "Flamingo" movement, but what started on Tuesday this week was on a different scale.

items.title: Patients in chains rescued from suspected illegal rehab centre in South Africa
items.description: Some of the 200 patients were found with "sores all over their bodies" and in overcrowded rooms.

items.title: China tells Israel to stop 'forced establishment' of West Bank settlements
items.description: Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi spoke to Israeli President Isaac Herzog on the sidelines of a conference.

items.title: At least 33 pupils and teacher killed after school roof collapses in Pakistan
items.description: Children were buried under the debris after the roof crashed through three classrooms, police say.

items.title: Trump calls off livestream of Fort Hood attacker's execution by firing squad
items.description: Trump said some would "rather not watch" the killing of Nidal Hasan, the first military execution in over 60 years.

items.title: Tip-off foiled US teen suspect's plot to attack Hindu temple, police say
items.description: The alleged plot only failed because the 19-year-old suspect's gun jammed outside the place of worship, say police.
